emn.text: Arlinn Kord, secretly a lycanthrope, is made an archmage of the Goldnight in the Elgaud chapel, hoping the blessing will repress her curse.

When devils attack Olaylie she prays to Avacyn and receives no answer, and Olaylie's agonized cry makes Arlinn lose herself and become a werewolf, who kills the cathars who try to stop her and then Olaylie.
As Rembert's sword falls she planeswalks away, and she lives as a werewolf with a human mind on another world, learning that she must trust herself to be whole.

Back on Innistrad she tries to seek Rembert's forgiveness, but he calls her a monster, and only when she kills a mad angel at the gorge, freeing him, does he take her hand and hear that they must find strength in each other now that Avacyn is gone.

mid.text: Arlinn Kord falls out with the werewolf Tovolar when she refuses to join a mass human hunt, and her own wolves side with him.
She asks the Gatewatch to help her find the Moonsilver Key, and Teferi, Kaya and Chandra agree, learning from the zombified Worrin Betzold and Dennick's spirit that the key went to Sorin Markov.
Sorin attacks her when Avacyn is mentioned, but Sigarda appears and stops him, and Arlinn takes the key from his quarters.

Tovolar's army attacks the Harvesttide festival, and Arlinn feigns surrender before overpowering him so that he retreats with his pack, but Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual and takes the key, and when Arlinn throws it to Olivia to save Katilda the Eternal Night begins.

vow.text: Arlinn Kord joins Katilda's Dawnhart Coven in planning a return to Harvesttide traditions beneath the Celestus, until Tovolar's howl interrupts them, and she sees that her own wolves want to hunt with him.
She brings Kaya, Teferi and Chandra to the coven and then finds the Moonsilver Key in Sorin's chambers, after Sigarda blocks his blow and tells her where to look.

At Harvesttide she confronts Tovolar, who refuses to call off the raid, and at sunset she changes into a wolf, but she tells him she is home, drives her claws into his sternum and makes him call a retreat.

She anoints the Sungold Lock with her blood so the Celestus stirs to life, but Olivia Voldaren seizes Katilda and Arlinn throws her the key, and afterward she argues that the endless night will starve the vampires too and proposes visiting Sorin Markov.
